title: Local annihilated representatives of annihilated germs
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $J$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaf data of finite type [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], and $F$ a quasi-coherent module sheaf [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $x\in X$ and $s\in F_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Suppose that the germ of every ideal section $a\in J(V)$ with $x\in V$ annihilates $s$. Then there exist an open neighborhood $U$ of $x$ and $t\in F(U)$ with germ $s$, such that $a(t|_V)=0$ for every subopen $V\subseteq U$ and $a\in J(V)$.

source.place: Properties, Tag 01PO (lemma-sections-annihilated-by-ideal), proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PO

proof.text: Choose an affine neighborhood Spec A of x; write F as M tilde and the ideal as I tilde. Identify F_x with localization of M at the prime of x. Finite type gives generators g_i of I. Write s=m/d with d outside the prime.

source.place: Properties, Tag 01PO (lemma-sections-annihilated-by-ideal), proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PO

proof.text: For each generator, the hypothesis gives g_i m/d=0. Clear a denominator t_i outside the prime, and set t to their product; then tm is killed by I. On D(td), the section tm/(td) has germ s and is killed by the extended ideal. The affine criterion gives local annihilation on every subopen. For no generators take t=1. This produces only a local representative, without making any global subsheaf choice.

theorem annihilator_stalk_local_lift (X : Scheme.{u}) (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    [J.toModules.IsFiniteType] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (x : X)
    (s : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj F)
    (hs : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U), ∀ a ∈ J.idealOfOpens U,
      X.presheaf.germ U x hx a • s = 0) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (t : Γ(F, U)),
      F.presheaf.germ U x hx t = s ∧
      ∀ (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U), ∀ a ∈ J.idealOfOpens V,
        a • F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op t = 0
